stem: A regression of weekly TV units on price, with no other predictors, gives a positive price coefficient: weeks with higher prices sold more TVs. What is the most likely reason?

options.text: Prices were higher in peak season, and season is not in the model
Customers prefer dearer TVs, so demand rises with every price rise
The coefficient should be read as a percent, which flips its sign
The model has too many weeks, which makes the sign unreliable
